model.title: A bill to require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Pleasant Valley Ranger District Administrative Site to Gila County, Arizona.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Mark Kelly (D-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would require the Forest Service to transfer approximately 232.9 acres of National Forest land in Arizona to Gila County, provided the county requests it in writing and agrees to use the property to serve and support veterans. The land would revert back to the federal government if the county ever stops using it for that purpose, and the county would be responsible for paying all costs associated with the transfer.
